items.question: What causes jaw pain?
items.answer: Jaw pain may result from TMJ disorders, teeth grinding, dental infections, wisdom teeth, arthritis, muscle strain, or bite problems.

items.question: When should I see a dentist for jaw pain?
items.answer: If your jaw pain lasts more than a few days, worsens over time, affects chewing, or is accompanied by swelling or difficulty opening your mouth, you should seek professional evaluation.

items.question: Can jaw pain be treated without surgery?
items.answer: Yes. Most jaw pain conditions can be effectively managed with conservative treatments such as bite correction, night guards, medications, physical therapy recommendations, or dental treatment.

items.question: How long does jaw pain treatment take?
items.answer: Treatment duration depends on the underlying cause. Some patients experience relief within days, while others may require ongoing management for chronic conditions.

items.question: What is the cost of jaw pain treatment in Pune?
items.answer: The cost varies depending on the diagnosis, required investigations, and recommended treatment. A consultation provides an accurate treatment estimate.

items.question: Can teeth grinding cause jaw pain?
items.answer: Yes. Chronic teeth grinding places excessive pressure on the jaw muscles and joints, often leading to pain, stiffness, headaches, and tooth wear.
